info.name: Subsidy Compliance Reminder & Automation Module
info.description: Postman collection to manage scheduled compliance scans, automatic transitions to NON_COMPLIANT, escalations, and reminder histories.

request.description: Triggers the automatic scan immediately (normally run on a 15-minute cron schedule). Identifies due-soon, overdue, and severely overdue records, updating statuses to NON_COMPLIANT, flagging applications, logging to Audit Logs, and writing to reminder histories.
Retrieves the history of all simulated SMS/Email/Dashboard notifications sent to the citizen for a specific compliance check.
